name: agent-inbox
title: Session Manager
description: 订阅 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话，等你输入时提醒，一键跳回原对话。Subscribe to Claude Code and Codex sessions, get notified when they wait for you, and jump back.
author: fango

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: 收件箱
commands.subtitle: Session Manager
commands.description: 只看该处理的会话：等我输入 / 运行中 / 已完成。Inbox of sessions that need you.

commands.name: all-sessions
commands.title: 全部会话
commands.subtitle: Session Manager
commands.description: 找到任意会话并订阅，包括历史会话。Find and subscribe to any session.

commands.name: subscribe-current
commands.title: 订阅当前会话
commands.subtitle: Session Manager
commands.description: 订阅前台窗口对应的会话，建议热键 ⌃⌥S。Subscribe to the session in the front window.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: 菜单栏
commands.subtitle: Session Manager
commands.description: 常驻显示等你输入的会话数。Shows how many sessions wait for you.

commands.name: setup
commands.title: 接入 Agent
commands.subtitle: Session Manager
commands.description: 写入 Claude Code / Codex 的 hooks（写入前展示内容）。Connect Claude Code and Codex.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: 语言 / Language
preferences.description: 界面与通知语言。Language for the interface and notifications.

preferences.name: resumeTerminal
preferences.title: 恢复会话用的终端 / Terminal
preferences.description: 原窗口已关闭时，在哪个终端里恢复 CLI 会话。Terminal used to resume a CLI session whose window is gone.
